modern4e.path.paragonpath120.description: Keep a spear poised between the enemy and your company, striking with greater accuracy and extending your reach when you spend an action point. With experience, careless movement and ranged attacks within that reach become chances to deal damage, while powerful thrusts push troublesome foes away. A defensive stance steadies your guard, and a deep, lingering wound makes every subsequent melee or ranged hit against your chosen target more punishing.
modern4e.path.paragonpath120.title: Longarm Marshal

modern4e.path.paragonpath121.description: Keep your shield between danger and your companions, then make enemies regret trying to fight past it. Attacks against nearby allies build force behind your next melee blow, while a sudden shield bash can stop a marked enemy cold with a stun. Between sheltering adjacent allies from incoming fire, reinforcing your own defenses, and answering a missed melee attack with dazing, weakening pressure, you give the party a sturdy place to rally.
modern4e.path.paragonpath121.title: Shield Adept

modern4e.path.paragonpath133.description: Hunt as a company, closing quickly and giving your companions the actions and movement they need to surround the prey. You can spend your own action point on an ally's turn in the spotlight, while cunning attacks lure enemies into striking each other and expose a victim to an ally's follow-up. When the formation needs to change, you can scatter willing companions clear of danger or sustain a veil of concealment over the whole pack.
modern4e.path.paragonpath133.title: Pack Master

modern4e.path.paragonpath14.description: Disappear in a flash of fey magic and leave the enemies beside your old position feeling the cut of your departure. Your action point turns bring a rush of accuracy, while fallen cursed enemies eventually offer an unpredictable choice of favors beyond your usual Misty Step. Between moving a creature into a fallen foe's place and twisting enemies into attacking their own companions, you make the battlefield feel treacherous to everyone caught in your wake.

prerequisites.reason: Class path prerequisite has not been structurally adapted.

modern4e.path.paragonpath14.title: Feytouched

modern4e.path.paragonpath152.description: A spear in your hands is a weapon of pursuit, pinning enemies in place and drawing them out of position as you slip around the battlefield. Frequent critical hits reward your precision, and a well-placed strike against a bloodied foe can lead straight into an attack against another enemy. With shifts to set up an action point assault or carry you away from a fallen opponent, you are always looking for the next opening.
modern4e.path.paragonpath152.title: Draeven Marauder

modern4e.path.paragonpath156.description: Trust a distant star to guide your fear and radiant magic toward devastating critical hits, with action point strikes leaving a lingering radiant wound. Its gifts can carry you unseen through the air or turn a cursed enemy's death into an ally's sudden attack, but those favors exact their payment in pain. When the need is greatest, you and your companions can offer healing surges for a chance to reclaim spent powers, gambling on how much the star will return.

prerequisites.reason: Class path prerequisite has not been structurally adapted.

modern4e.path.paragonpath156.title: Student of Caiphon

modern4e.path.paragonpath160.description: Plant yourself in the thick of the fighting and keep advancing when wounds and afflictions would stop another warrior. A deeper reserve of health lets you endure punishment and even pay in blood to shake off lingering effects, while bursts of damage resistance help you weather the enemy's answer. Your attacks carry you forward with short shifts and invigorating blows, leaving battered enemies displaced or dazed in your wake.
modern4e.path.paragonpath160.title: Dreadnought

modern4e.path.paragonpath166.description: Make the space around your reach weapon dangerous, dragging enemies out of position and shoving them farther than they expect. Your daily stance lets you punish openings with opportunity attacks across your weapon's reach, and later even a marked enemy two squares away must think twice before shifting or attacking an ally. Long lunges, sweeping blows, and forceful slides let you dictate where the fight happens before an enemy ever reaches your side.
modern4e.path.paragonpath166.title: Polearm Master

modern4e.path.paragonpath168.description: Get inside an enemy's guard and stay there, weaving between strikes as you look for a chance to bury another blade. Off-hand weapons hit harder in your grip, and Dexterity eventually rewards attacks made with combat advantage, making careful positioning worth the effort. Your powers can build into a three-hit assault, turn a miss into better footing or protection, and use a free hand to seize an enemy for a vicious close-range strike.
modern4e.path.paragonpath168.title: Shock Trooper

modern4e.path.paragonpath189.description: Lead with a fearless surge, lending force and accuracy to your companions when you spend an action point. Your inspiring word can urge a wounded ally into a stronger attack, though a failed opening leaves that ally exposed, and your killing stroke can set off a chain of attacks as companions bring down foes in turn. Resistance to fear and enemy marks helps you keep moving, while your greatest maneuver carries you through several enemies in a storm of individual blows.
modern4e.path.paragonpath189.title: Battlelord of Kord

modern4e.path.paragonpath195.description: Arrange the fight so that an enemy caught between you and an ally pays for every exposed flank. Your action points can rescue an ally's failed attack, and a second Commanding Presence eventually gives you more ways to shape the company's decisive moments. Feints undermine enemy accuracy, while flexible orders let an ally's action point become the occasion for healing, a stronger attack, or a daring extra maneuver.

prerequisites.reason: Class path prerequisite has not been structurally adapted.

modern4e.path.paragonpath195.title: Infernal Strategist

modern4e.path.paragonpath198.description: Keep two companions in the fight with one inspiring word, trading its usual extra healing for a wider rally. Your action points lend nearby allies greater accuracy, and their second winds eventually bring stronger protection, making recovery part of the company's advance. A shared stance lets you and one ally choose the better of two attack rolls each turn, while your greatest assault rewards companions who have already caught their breath with a fresh opening to strike.
modern4e.path.paragonpath198.title: Twiceborn Leader

modern4e.path.paragonpath21.description: Choose a melee weapon and master it until every cut, thrust, or crushing blow lands with exceptional precision and force. That commitment rewards you with lasting accuracy and damage, backed by the option to spend an action point correcting a crucial roll and a parry that softens a punishing hit. At your most fluid, you pass between several enemies in a single sequence, leaving each struck foe on the ground and unable to move.
modern4e.path.paragonpath21.title: Kensei

modern4e.path.paragonpath219.description: Fight as though every exchange should leave something broken, tearing through resistances and opening gaps in enemy armor at the cost of your own protection. Spending an action point unleashes a particularly destructive turn, while critical hits restore some of your health and missed melee strikes help you find your mark on the next attempt. You thrive on relentless pressure, leaving wounds that keep bleeding and make your follow-up attacks harder to escape.
modern4e.path.paragonpath219.title: Doomguard Marauder

modern4e.path.paragonpath222.description: Stand ready to trade places with a threatened companion, turning a sudden rescue into an opening for both your blades. Your magic lets you appear at an ally's side to reinforce their defenses, while your elemental training eventually adds a chosen energy to every attack. When the fighting grows fierce, a wider assault or shielding aegis and resistance-breaking attacks help you keep control, culminating in an elemental eruption that lets your allies teleport clear.
modern4e.path.paragonpath222.title: Malec-Keth Janissary

modern4e.path.paragonpath223.description: Treat distance and planar boundaries as problems you already know how to solve, gaining portal lore and a long teleport alongside your action point maneuver. In battle, you can banish an enemy long enough to change the odds, and later your presence keeps nearby allies from being teleported against their will. Your portals offer a swift escape to a known circle at a steep cost in healing surges, while your greatest attack sends a foe through a succession of hostile planes and brings it back still suffering.
modern4e.path.paragonpath223.title: Planeshifter

modern4e.path.paragonpath258.description: Take on a bear's shape when you rage, gaining tougher protection and the freedom to catch your breath with second wind without slowing your assault. Action points offer further healing, while mauling blows knock enemies down and threaten another strike when they stand beside you. Your growing strength sends foes flying on a raging critical hit, and your fiercest rage carries you between opponents before settling into steady regeneration and resistance to being moved.
modern4e.path.paragonpath258.title: Bear Warrior

modern4e.path.paragonpath26.description: Keep a blade fight moving in your favor, turning a critical hit into another use of a spent Fighter encounter attack. Your swordplay carries selected at-will techniques into a charge and gives you a precise strike against Reflex that can punish an opening as an opportunity attack. Defensive bursts help you survive a committed assault, while your great sweeping attack can recover a spent daily power and leave you ready for another decisive exchange.
modern4e.path.paragonpath26.title: Swordmaster

modern4e.path.paragonpath275.description: Stalk the battlefield with a hunter's stealth and agility, sharing concealment of your approach with allies gathered around your spirit companion. An action point exposes nearby enemies to combat advantage, and your spirit can sap the strength of bloodied prey. Sudden leaps help you escape attacks, while a gathering of panther spirits lets your whole company teleport into striking distance.
modern4e.path.paragonpath275.title: Ghost Panther

modern4e.path.paragonpath276.description: Make your spirit companion a rallying point for warriors, strengthening attacks against marked enemies and helping allies punish foes that drop their guard. Spending an action point gives a companion a melee attack, and a commanding roar lets the party reposition. Your spirit's heaviest blows mark enemies, knock them down for attacking, or leave them suffering retaliation whenever they hit.
modern4e.path.paragonpath276.title: Great Bear Shaman

modern4e.path.paragonpath28.description: Take ground by force, driving enemies backward and hammering them to the floor while your allies advance behind you. With experience, those pushes and knockdowns become a source of damage in their own right, making Constitution as useful for breaking the enemy line as enduring it. Each kill restores a little health, and your action point defenses and last-moment surge of action help you hold on when the battle turns against you.
modern4e.path.paragonpath28.title: Iron Vanguard

modern4e.path.paragonpath31.description: Pay for greater spell damage with your own blood, turning self-inflicted wounds into power behind your most demanding attacks. An action point attack leaves its victims bleeding, while your second wind can set already-afflicted enemies alight. Your spells punish foes for moving and leave crowds dazed beneath lingering psychic pain, and you can sacrifice a healing surge to recover a spent encounter power when the battle demands more magic.
modern4e.path.paragonpath31.title: Blood Mage

modern4e.path.paragonpath315.description: Look past a creature's imposing hide or ghostly form and find the weakness your blade can exploit. Your action point attack pierces resistance and insubstantial protection, while critical hits and carefully placed strikes punish existing vulnerabilities and later attacks wear through resistance more easily. An elemental stance lets you create vulnerabilities of your own, setting up attacks from you and your companions to bite deeper into the same wounded prey.

prerequisites.reason: Class path prerequisite has not been structurally adapted.

modern4e.path.paragonpath315.title: Arcane Hunter

modern4e.path.paragonpath316.description: Slip between solid form and ghostly presence, emerging from a teleport with an opening for your next weapon strike. Spending an action point makes you insubstantial, and your defensive magic can also let you pass through obstacles, with later benefits extending your teleports and exposing marked enemies while you remain elusive. Your blade can cut through an insubstantial foe's protection, and your greatest assault carries you from enemy to enemy before returning you to where you began.
modern4e.path.paragonpath316.title: Ghost Blade

modern4e.path.paragonpath318.description: Make your side of the battlefield a refuge, tracing wards that strengthen the defenses of companions standing beside you. An enemy that strikes one of those companions despite your mark can eventually feel your blade from well beyond its normal reach, making your shelter dangerous to challenge. Extra shielding marks, timely rescue teleports, and a sigil that lends force to your allies' melee attacks let you protect the group without surrendering the initiative.

prerequisites.reason: Class path prerequisite has not been structurally adapted.

modern4e.path.paragonpath318.title: Sigil Carver

modern4e.path.paragonpath319.description: Answer an enemy's defiance with a spell-laden blade, replacing your assault aegis's ordinary retaliation with a Swordmage at-will attack. An action point charge can carry an even stronger technique into the enemy line, and later a successful melee blow can open the way for a quick additional spell. With another aegis mark to spread your attention and attacks charged with elemental force, you press your advantage through sudden, concentrated violence.

prerequisites.reason: Class path prerequisite has not been structurally adapted.

modern4e.path.paragonpath319.title: Sword of Assault

modern4e.path.paragonpath322.description: Hold enemies in a fascination they struggle to shake, making nearby foes especially vulnerable to lingering charms and other effects. Your enchantments draw victims out of position, turn a missed attack against you into a dazed hesitation, and eventually grow more accurate and forgiving when an encounter charm fails entirely. At the height of your influence, a crowd must choose between surrendering its actions and enduring a punishing psychic torment.
modern4e.path.paragonpath322.title: Entrancing Mystic

modern4e.path.paragonpath325.description: Let your curse reach past the nearest victim and settle on the enemy you actually want to torment. As your hexes deepen, curse damage can tug foes out of position, while an action point leaves everyone already cursed struggling to strike true. Your spells spread that influence across a crowd, answer distant attackers with a fresh curse, and make gathering beside one chosen victim an invitation to share its misfortune.
modern4e.path.paragonpath325.title: Hexer

modern4e.path.paragonpath329.description: Step through space as easily as another wizard crosses a room, eventually gaining teleportation as a normal way to move. Critical hits let you teleport your victims, and an action point carries you to a better position before the fight can pin you down. Your spells send allies to safety and enemies into danger, whisk you away from an incoming attack, and finally strand a group of creatures in an interplanar space until they find their way back.
modern4e.path.paragonpath329.title: Arcane Wayfarer

modern4e.path.paragonpath330.description: Build a lasting bond with your summoned creatures, keeping them in the fight with healing and, eventually, regeneration. An action point lets you command each of your summons, while conjuration and summoning spells carry you a short teleport out of danger. A planar gateway scatters creatures that stray too close, and your greatest servant is a towering protector that dazes crowds, knocks attackers down, and can trade places with you in an instant.
modern4e.path.paragonpath330.title: Bonded Summoner

modern4e.path.paragonpath332.description: Speak winter into your summons, granting yourself and your servants resistance to cold before surrounding them with a frostbite aura that harms any creature lingering nearby. An action point chills and slows adjacent enemies, while your spells raise an obscuring wall of ice and wind or infuse a fresh summon with cold immunity and harder-hitting attacks. Your greatest calling brings forth a rimefire brute that knocks foes down, freezes groups in place, and spreads its killing cold farther across the battlefield.
modern4e.path.paragonpath332.title: Rimetongue Caller

modern4e.path.paragonpath349.description: Let one enemy's fall carry the nightmare onward, spreading your curse or unsettling a foe already caught in it. Action point attacks pull cursed enemies out of position, your encounter spells eventually gain rattling, and Shadow Walk can hide you completely from those you have cursed. Your most personal terrors leave a victim dazed and vulnerable to follow-up blows, or give it a relentless illusory pursuer that strikes when its attacks fail.

prerequisites.reason: Class path prerequisite has not been structurally adapted.

modern4e.path.paragonpath349.title: Nightmare Weaver

modern4e.path.paragonpath351.description: Master the fundamentals of arcane magic until even your simplest spells set up stronger follow-up attacks and strike with greater force. Your schooling sharpens your Arcana knowledge, while an action point gives you a chance to correct a missed attack. You can pour extra power into familiar spells, reclaim an encounter attack that misses every target, and eventually turn a practiced encounter spell into a more punishing assault with longer-lasting effects.
modern4e.path.paragonpath351.title: Academy Master

modern4e.path.paragonpath361.description: Carry winter into the fight, adding cold to a chosen encounter spell and resisting the chill yourself. Your action point attacks drive that cold through resistance, while later teleports leave nearby enemies hurting and slowed in the place you abandoned. By exposing a foe to deeper cold, reclaiming a spent cold spell, and laying a creeping frost that can progress into a stun, you make each escape feel further away.

prerequisites.reason: Class path prerequisite has not been structurally adapted.

modern4e.path.paragonpath361.title: Long Night Scion

modern4e.path.paragonpath46.description: Seize the opening moments of battle, giving nearby allies the accuracy to make their first attacks count. Your action points sharpen the company's attacks again, and later your inspiring word sends a recovered ally back into the fight with better accuracy and speed, especially under Tactical Presence. Forceful strikes clear space around the enemy line, while a moment of inspired command lets an ally bring a spent encounter attack back into play.
modern4e.path.paragonpath46.title: Battle Captain

modern4e.path.paragonpath462.description: Fight with a Battlerager's fury, using invigorating attacks to sustain the brawl and turning a missed swing into greater accuracy on the next attack. An action point gives your weapon attacks a sustained surge of force, while a growing reserve of health keeps you in the crush of bodies. Wide, angry blows send enemies sprawling, your stance draws attackers into your marks, and foes felled by your greatest assault risk another strike when they try to stand beside you.

prerequisites.reason: Class path prerequisite has not been structurally adapted.

modern4e.path.paragonpath462.title: Wrathbearer

modern4e.path.paragonpath47.description: Become the armored center of the advance, giving companions beside you the confidence to strike more accurately. Your action points reinforce the company's defenses, and nearby opportunity attacks eventually gain extra force, making a tightly held line dangerous to cross. Your own attacks drive enemies back or draw them into your marks, while your greatest assault leaves surrounding foes bleeding and makes that suffering harder to shake while they remain beside you.

prerequisites.reason: Class path prerequisite has not been structurally adapted.

modern4e.path.paragonpath47.title: Knight Commander

modern4e.path.paragonpath475.description: Draw the enemy's attention with the strength of the ancestors behind you, marking foes and making your exchanges with them increasingly punishing. Charisma deepens your healing reserves, and a successful action point attack lets you spend a healing surge to stay in the fight. As your bond grows, Rampage can carry an at-will technique into the opening, while your greatest rage adds force to every blow against an enemy you have marked.
modern4e.path.paragonpath475.title: Ancestral Weapon

modern4e.path.paragonpath477.description: Focus your anger into deliberate Rage Strikes, using them even before you enter a rage and eventually putting greater force behind each blow. Spending an action point restores health, and a precise strike against Reflex lets you draw on a healing surge. A critical hit can turn Rampage into another use of that healing attack, while your greatest rage steadies the accuracy of at-will attacks and Rage Strikes and rewards their hits with temporary vitality.
modern4e.path.paragonpath477.title: Calm Fury

modern4e.path.paragonpath479.description: Endure with the patience of stone, then erupt in a rush of heat and violence. You can turn some critical hits against you into ordinary wounds, and an action point attack adds Constitution-driven fire damage while knocking its victims down. Remaining outside a rage lets you shelter behind broad damage resistance, while being bloodied brings fire resistance and harder blows. When you finally unleash your volcanic rage, nearby enemies burn each turn and those that strike you leave themselves open to your answer.
modern4e.path.paragonpath479.title: Stonefire Rager

modern4e.path.paragonpath481.description: Freeze enemies in place and make their helpless footing count, striking immobilized foes with greater accuracy and force. Your action point attacks can lock down a cluster of enemies, while a mantle of glacial armor absorbs punishment until repeated blows or fire break it apart. With experience, you resist the cold and can turn ordinary damage into frost, and your greatest rage lets each at-will hit hold its victim in place for another assault.
modern4e.path.paragonpath481.title: Winter Fury

modern4e.path.paragonpath489.description: Keep your companions moving with helpful gusts, sliding them as you heal and helping them recover their footing after enemies push them around. An action point lets nearby allies slip into better positions, while protective winds carry one companion away from approaching foes. Your attacks open routes through enemy spaces or unleash a hurricane that scatters and dazes the opposition.
modern4e.path.paragonpath489.title: Disciple of Winds

modern4e.path.paragonpath491.description: Let your spirit companion grow into a larger guardian, extending its reach and sheltering more allies around its presence. Your attacks and action points reinforce nearby companions' defenses, while your own resolve can protect them from attacks against Will. A hymn of nature offers another burst of protection, and your greatest evocation forces nearby enemies to choose between hesitation and psychic pain.

prerequisites.reason: Class path prerequisite has not been structurally adapted.

modern4e.path.paragonpath491.title: Great Elder

modern4e.path.paragonpath492.description: Use your spirit companion's vantage point to guide ranged and area attacks around obstacles, eventually reaching enemies from much farther away. Spending an action point briefly brings a second companion into the fight, spreading your spirit's influence across two positions. Your eagle guides allies' shots and exposes enemies to critical hits, turning a carefully chosen target into an opening for the whole party.

prerequisites.reason: Class path prerequisite has not been structurally adapted.

modern4e.path.paragonpath492.title: Keen Eagle

modern4e.path.paragonpath494.description: Read the battle's omens to help your company act sooner and put an extra action into the hands of the ally who needs it most. When one companion falls, another receives healing, and your spirit can answer an enemy's blow with damage equal to what it inflicted. You can carry a useful die result into your next roll or call on winter to frustrate a foe's saving throws.
modern4e.path.paragonpath494.title: Seasons' Herald

modern4e.path.paragonpath513.description: Bring a two-handed weapon to bear on an exposed enemy and keep pounding until the defense gives way. Combat advantage adds Constitution-driven force to your blows, while repeated at-will hits help line up the next attack and an action point can put extra weight behind a strike that has already landed. As enemies fall, fresh opponents grant you openings, letting you carry the assault onward with dazing blows, bleeding wounds, and punishing knockdowns.

prerequisites.reason: Class path prerequisite has not been structurally adapted.
prerequisites.text: One-Handed Weapon Talent or Two-Handed Weapon Talent

modern4e.path.paragonpath513.requirements: One-Handed Weapon Talent or Two-Handed Weapon Talent
modern4e.path.paragonpath513.title: Siegebreaker

modern4e.path.paragonpath544.description: Move with an athlete's freedom even in chainmail or scale, closing the distance with a charge that can send an enemy sprawling whether the blow lands or not. A kill gives you a chance to catch your breath with second wind, while spending an action point lets you reposition and attack with greater confidence. As your prowess grows, greater speed and a powerful battle stance help you press the attack, stand your ground, and make ignoring your challenge a costly gamble.

prerequisites.reason: Class path prerequisite has not been structurally adapted.

modern4e.path.paragonpath544.title: Glorious Myrmidon

modern4e.path.paragonpath548.description: Pick a target beyond the enemy line and charge straight through the bodies in your way. Foes that catch you with opportunity attacks can end up on their backs, while your own attacks scatter enemies or turn your arrival into a sweeping blow against the surrounding crowd. Spending an action point gives a charge extra force, and bringing one enemy down can send you thundering straight toward the next.
modern4e.path.paragonpath548.title: Rampaging Brute

modern4e.path.paragonpath550.description: Recover your footing and come back harder, turning a spent healing surge into renewed accuracy in melee. You can trade an action point for healing, strike to mend your own wounds, and lean on your shield to strengthen your resolve against attacks on Will. A commanding stance steadies nearby allies while troubling marked enemies until a hit breaks it, and your fiercest assault can bind one foe to your challenge while leaving others easier to bring down.
modern4e.path.paragonpath550.title: Warhound of Bane

modern4e.path.paragonpath575.description: Keep your company fighting past the point where its strength should have failed, lending nearby allies temporary health as your blade lands. Your own reserves run deeper, and second wind eventually restores a spent encounter attack, while spending an action point helps your companions finish bloodied enemies. A sweeping assault can draw enemy attention onto you and return encounter attacks to several allies, rewarding a battle in which you have already spent your encouragement freely.
modern4e.path.paragonpath575.title: Arkhosian Blademaster

modern4e.path.paragonpath577.description: Make good fortune look like sound command, smoothing out poor weapon damage rolls and giving allies the chance to roll attacks or damage again. Your action point attacks provide temporary health to you or nearby companions, and later you can spend two action points in one encounter across different rounds. When a dangerous enemy needs its luck broken, your lasting mark forces it to risk the worse of two attack rolls whenever it turns on an ally.
modern4e.path.paragonpath577.title: Captain of Fortune

modern4e.path.paragonpath59.description: Draw spells from the arcane storm around you, using Wisdom to determine how powerful a spent spell you can reclaim each day. An action point strengthens your attacks for the turn, and becoming bloodied eventually answers your enemies with a burst of lightning. Your magic cages creatures behind a crackling wall, sweeps a moving curtain of rain across the battlefield, and scatters enemies through a maelstrom of force and teleportation.
modern4e.path.paragonpath59.title: Spellstorm Mage

modern4e.path.paragonpath646.description: Feed your companions' momentum with soulfire, turning critical hits into greater speed, sharper reflexes, and extra fire damage on their attacks. Spending an action point spreads that power to several companions at once. Your evocations scorch groups of enemies, and empowered allies can become moving sources of heat that burn nearby foes. Even destroying your spirit companion can unleash a final burst of flame.
modern4e.path.paragonpath646.title: Soul Igniter

modern4e.path.paragonpath647.description: Gather lightning, rain, and wind around your spirit companion, punishing enemies that attack it and dazing those that destroy it. Your action points help the company reposition, while storm spirits lend lightning damage to allied attacks and protect nearby companions from lightning and thunder. Driving rain conceals allies and exposes enemies to the storm, and a powerful cyclone knocks foes down while opening paths for your companions.
modern4e.path.paragonpath647.title: Stormcaller

modern4e.path.paragonpath648.description: Expose weaknesses where your enemies seem to have none, letting allies strike through ghostly bodies and pierce elemental defenses. Your spirit attacks interrupt regeneration, while an action point or a well-placed strike leaves a foe vulnerable to extra damage. You can also borrow an enemy's resistances for nearby allies and make a wounded foe suffer whenever it lands a blow against them.
modern4e.path.paragonpath648.title: Animus Predator

modern4e.path.paragonpath649.description: Turn your spirit companion into a source of recovery, strengthening Healing Spirit and giving its target the option to seek relief from a lingering affliction instead of healing. Your action points restore nearby allies, and second wind becomes an opportunity to return to the attack. Cleansing waves and a movable sanctuary help companions recover, resist disease, and shake off effects that saving throws can end.
modern4e.path.paragonpath649.title: Scion of Renewal

modern4e.path.paragonpath656.description: Draw enemies into a close, ugly brawl where hurting one can hurt the others and slipping away becomes increasingly difficult. Your attacks arrange the melee in your allies' favor, and your finishing stance can leave nearby enemies rooted in place as you cut into a bloodied opponent. Being bloodied yourself only sharpens the contest, giving you a stronger action point attack and the footwork to turn an enemy's hit into a new opening.
modern4e.path.paragonpath656.title: Gladiator Champion

modern4e.path.paragonpath66.description: Train for the battlefield, turning a chosen single-target wizard spell into a basic attack that fits naturally into your companions' tactics. Your action point attacks let you cast ranged and area spells without provoking opportunity attacks, while critical hits with close and area attacks eventually punish every target more severely. Sweeping lightning prepares your next strike, a selective barrier shields you from distant attacks while letting your spells through, and a thunderous assault leaves its targets open to your allies.
modern4e.path.paragonpath66.title: War Wizard of Cormyr

modern4e.path.paragonpath663.description: Give wounded primal spirits a voice, turning their anger into elemental protection for an ally and vengeance against your enemies. Your daily attacks bolster nearby companions and let them reposition, while a restorative wind heals and shields the group. Psychic commands force foes to strike one another, and your greatest outcry can stun a crowd before drawing the most vulnerable minds under your control.
modern4e.path.paragonpath663.title: Voice for the Ravaged

modern4e.path.paragonpath692.description: Give yourself completely to fire, spreading burning wounds and eventually widening every arcane fire burst and blast you cast. Critical hits kindle lingering flames, and an action point scorches enemies gathered beside you. You can fan an existing blaze into a second explosion, become an insubstantial creature of fire whose touch punishes melee attackers, and raise a hungry inferno that drags nearby creatures toward its center.
modern4e.path.paragonpath692.title: Master of Flame

modern4e.path.paragonpath73.description: Meet danger with a patient guard, turning your shielding aegis into a reserve of temporary health while strengthening your own magical defenses. When an enemy reaches for an ally, a thunderous counterstroke can drive it out of reach before its blow lands. Defensive surges and a lasting ward help you endure the pressure, while a powerful finishing strike sends a troublesome foe elsewhere on the battlefield.
modern4e.path.paragonpath73.title: Coronal Guard

modern4e.path.paragonpath76.description: Read the battlefield with a traveler's eye, letting Wisdom widen the reach of your assault or shielding aegis and guide a sharp answer to enemies that wound you deeply. Teleport before an action point maneuver, or catch a marked attacker in a magical snare that carries both of you away from your threatened ally. Your adaptable swordplay tests whichever defense looks weakest, while a circling guard of spectral blades can shelter companions and steadily cut at nearby foes.
modern4e.path.paragonpath76.title: Wandering Swordmage

modern4e.path.paragonpath771.description: Lead a luminous counterattack, turning a successful strike into a chance to spend an action point on an ally's recovery. Your healing eventually lets companions add radiant power to their attacks, while a blazing corona can blind surrounding enemies and leave you free to strike one still able to see. A field of holy light offers allies strength, protection, or healing, and your greatest rally sends the whole nearby company into a shared melee assault.
modern4e.path.paragonpath771.title: Sainted General

modern4e.path.paragonpath807.description: Bend enemy minds through a spirit companion that projects your powers from its own position. Psychic assaults daze and move foes, while your strongest binding can dominate a victim and drag it along with the spirit. An action point makes your attack's lingering effects harder to shake off, and enemies that destroy your companion are dazed in return. You can also interpose it against an incoming blow.
modern4e.path.paragonpath807.title: Phrenic Master

modern4e.path.paragonpath834.description: Hunt through the boundary between the world and its shadows, passing through obstacles as you charge a visible enemy. An action point spent on a successful at-will attack can send you straight into another charge, while a brutal follow-up blow grants temporary vitality. Shadow packmates flank enemies alongside your companions, and your later gifts let you spend a healing surge to move through solid barriers or leave lingering necrotic and poisonous wounds with every melee hit.
modern4e.path.paragonpath834.title: Nocturnal

modern4e.path.paragonpath99.description: Win the close fight with hard-earned toughness and the sort of dirty tricks that make every opening hurt. Your armor serves you better, your action point turns hit harder, and Wisdom eventually adds bite to your Fighter and Pit Fighter weapon attacks. A dazing follow-up jab and vicious payback keep opponents under pressure, while a brutal finish against a wounded foe can send the rest scrambling away.
modern4e.path.paragonpath99.title: Pit Fighter
